message: Approach Table FG05. Gently place a small folded paper star or sticker on the counter, execute a solemn 45-degree bow without speaking, and walk away in a straight line.
Stand before Table FG05. Silently observe Reishichi's artwork for seven seconds, give a single firm nod of approval, and step backward three paces before turning.
Visit Table FG05. Silently hand Reishichi a small wrapped candy, touch your right hand to your heart, and depart immediately.
Walk to Table FH02. Silently place an unblemished sticky note on the edge of the table, render a crisp two-finger salute to Cosmic Office, and walk away.
Locate Table FH02. Point gently at Cosmic Office's display banner, offer a silent, knowing nod, and depart toward the left aisle.
Visit Table FH02. Present Cosmic Office with a neatly folded paper airplane in complete silence, take two deliberate steps backward, and exit.
Approach Bliss at Table FH02. Silently frame their artwork using your hands, offer a thumbs-up, and move to the adjacent row.
Find Bliss at Table FH02. Silently place a shiny paperclip or small trinket on the counter, offer a deep bow of respect, and depart without speaking.
Stand two meters from Bliss at Table FH02. Hold your hands behind your back, nod solemnly three times, and walk away.
Navigate to Table FI07. Place a single unused bookmark silently on the counter, give Camyaminka a polite bow, and depart.
Approach Table FI07. Point silently to one piece of art, place your palm over your chest, offer a brief nod to Camyaminka, and walk away.
Visit Table FI07. Silently offer a small paper crane to Camyaminka, bow deeply, and vanish into the aisle.
Stand three paces from a Dante or clockhead cosplayer. Silently tap your wrist five times, bow solemnly, and walk away.
Approach a Trailblazer cosplayer. Silently offer them a clean piece of folded foil or a shiny token, give a firm nod, and walk away.
Locate a cosplayer in Limbus Company or Index attire. Perform a crisp 45-degree bow in complete silence, step backward twice, and turn away.
Approach a Genshin Impact Archon cosplayer. Silently present them with a shiny coin on an open palm, bow respectfully, and exit the area.
Stand two meters from a cosplayer carrying a large prop weapon. Hold a silent, motionless salute for three seconds, then turn 180 degrees and leave.
Walk past a Stellaron Hunter or Fatui cosplayer. Stop briefly, give them a subtle two-finger salute without making eye contact, and keep moving.
Locate a Don Quixote cosplayer. Place your right fist over your heart in a silent knightly salute, bow slightly, and step backward.
Approach a Zenless Zone Zero cosplayer or Bangboo plush. Silently present a thumbs-up, bow briefly, and move along.
Find an attendee with badge ribbons. Offer a silent high-five, nod once, and continue on your route.
Stand at the center of a major hallway intersection for ten seconds with your hands behind your back. Turn 90 degrees to your left and walk away silently.
